summary: Reject nonzero JSON floats that underflow to zero and reject NUL-containing output paths before analysis, preserving existing file admission and export behavior.
API: Existing read_document, render_json, preflight_output and run_export APIs remain unchanged. Nonzero underflow raises input-free Refusal; true signed zero and representable subnormals remain valid. NUL output paths raise Refusal before the trusted analyzer callback; post-work export failures still raise ExportError carrying evidence.

tests.command: uv run --no-sync pytest tests/unit/test_parity_io.py tests/integration/test_parity_io_composition.py tests/unit/test_rerank_parity.py tests/integration/test_rerank_parity_composition.py tests/unit/test_contracts.py -q

limitations: Synthetic owned fixtures only; no real model or hardware qualification. Existing trusted operator-parent and hard-link assumptions apply; preflight is advisory and export is not atomic or durable. CLI routing and embedding composition remain for integration. No push, PR, merge, deployment or real service access.
